item.title: OpenBSD: PF queues break the 4 Gbps barrier
item.description:
📝 However, an internal 32-bit limitation in the HFSC service curve structure (struct hfsc_sc) meant that bandwidth values were silently capped at approximately 4. Configuring bandwidth 10G on a queue would silently wrap around, producing incorrect and unpredictable scheduling behaviour. The familiar syntax just does what you'd expect: queue rootq on em0 bandwidth 10G queue defq parent rootq bandwidth 8G default Values up to 999G are supported, more than enough for interfaces today and the future.
🔗 Read more: https://undeadly.org/cgi?action=article;sid=20260319125859

item.title: Juggalo Makeup Blocks Facial Recognition Technology (2019)
item.description:
📝 It turns out that Juggalos face makeup cannot be accurately read by many facial recognition technologies. it turns out juggalo makeup defeats facial recognition successfully. Since makeup only changes the apparent shape of your chin and not the depth of your dimples, Apple’s facial recognition renders the Juggalo makeup workaround useless.
🔗 Read more: https://consequence.net/2019/07/juggalo-makeup-facial-recognition/
